confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bruges and Belgian price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is least certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by location and date. The FX observation comes from RBA exchange-rate results returned by search; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Belgian and northwest European historic tourist cities (e.g., Ghent, Antwerp, Leuven), with a high-season uplift for accommodation and a Bruges tourism premium on mid-range dining and bars.
